found: Concrete flags on the recipe's own joint grid, each flag a slightly different grey, with dark gum spots, scuffs across the flag faces and dirt gathered in the joints. It reads as a footway that has been walked on. No lettering, numeral, logo, watermark, utility cover, tactile paving or inspection mark, and no kerb or drain that would tie it to a particular street.
statement: Every texel of every map is inside exactly one of these crops, each written at 1:1 with no resampling, and each was looked at before this set was offered for publication.
